tasks.title: serialize_child_brief_to_markdown: carry working_dir into child-brief frontmatter (NGv2 epic prop 1/3)
acceptance_criteria: harness/planner/brief_generator.py::serialize_child_brief_to_markdown emits a `working_dir:` frontmatter key (a YAML double-quoted scalar) when brief_data carries a non-empty string `working_dir`, so load_brief recovers it.
When `working_dir` is absent, None, empty, or whitespace-only, NO working_dir frontmatter key is emitted and the existing output is unchanged (backward compatible).

The working_dir key coexists with the existing dependencies/interfaces frontmatter, and the frontmatter block is still only emitted when at least one optional key (working_dir, dependencies, or interfaces) is present.
The committed oracle tests/planner/test_brief_generator_working_dir.py passes 4/4 and tests/planner/test_brief_generator.py still passes.

spec.objective: Close step 1/3 of the NobleGreedv2 epic auto-decompose working_dir propagation: the child-brief markdown serializer drops working_dir, so an epic-generated child brief loads with working_dir=None and the child plan never targets the external repo. Make serialize_child_brief_to_markdown serialize a non-empty working_dir into the YAML frontmatter (which load_brief already reads, brief_loader.py:196,225).
functional_requirements: If isinstance(working_dir, str) and working_dir.strip(): append a frontmatter line `working_dir: ` + _double_quote(working_dir) to frontmatter_lines (reusing the existing local _double_quote helper).

Keep the existing dependencies and interfaces frontmatter handling and the 'frontmatter only when non-empty' rule intact: the frontmatter block is emitted when frontmatter_lines is non-empty (now including the working_dir case).
spec.interfaces: harness/planner/brief_generator.py::serialize_child_brief_to_markdown(brief_data: dict) -> str signature is UNCHANGED. The new line uses the existing nested _double_quote helper. Ordering among optional keys is unconstrained.
edge_cases: brief_data with working_dir='/abs/path' -> frontmatter has working_dir: "/abs/path"; load_brief(written).working_dir == '/abs/path'.
brief_data with working_dir and dependencies and interfaces -> all three round-trip.
brief_data without working_dir -> output byte-identical to prior behaviour (no working_dir key).
brief_data with working_dir='   ' (whitespace) -> no working_dir key emitted.
non_goals: Do not change load_brief or any other module; load_brief already reads working_dir from frontmatter.
Do not change the five required section headings or their rendering.
Do not add a new module-level import or a new top-level symbol; reuse the nested _double_quote helper.
Do not use eval, exec, or __import__.
spec.implementation_notes:
Emit a SINGLE kind:'symbol' partial-edit patch via __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ with name 'serialize_child_brief_to_markdown' (a small top-level function). Insert the working_dir handling alongside the existing dependencies/interfaces blocks that build frontmatter_lines, e.g. after the interfaces block:

    working_dir = brief_data.get('working_dir')
    if isinstance(working_dir, str) and working_dir.strip():
        frontmatter_lines.append('working_dir: ' + _double_quote(working_dir))

The rest of the function (sections rendering, frontmatter-only-when-non-empty) is unchanged.
